# Clip editor control inventory (auto-generated testids + manual keyboard)

## Keyboard shortcuts (unchanged by revamp)

See `lib/clips/editor/timeline-shortcuts.ts` and `timeline/shortcuts-sheet.tsx`. Global: Space play/pause, J/K/L shuttle, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Delete selection. Timeline focus: S split, V/R/U/Y/B/H tools, N snap, zoom +/-/0, arrows nudge, ? help. Full list in shortcuts overlay.
